scheme_name: One-Time Settlement (OTS) scheme for pending e-challans
note: Odisha's OTS, approved by the cabinet on 10 September 2025 and notified by the Commerce and Transport Department in September–October 2025, let violators settle e-challans pending as of 31 July 2025 at half the prescribed fine (for example ₹5,000 licence offences settled at ₹2,500). Challans already sent to court as prosecution reports were excluded. The scheme ran for six months from notification, so the window ended around March–April 2026; no extension had been announced as of 13 August 2026.
